$comment: Every evidence source the DeviceManagementEvidence contract can name, and what actually stands behind it. Never hand-drift this from lib/integration-bridge/src/evidence.ts — scripts/check-evidence-sources.mjs enforces the bijection in both directions and will fail the build. Adding a source means adding an entry here AND the converter it names; the gate refuses either one alone.

statuses.converter: A product converter exists and is exported from the named module. This is the only status that means SignalGrid can ingest this source.
statuses.proof_only: The id is constructed inline inside a proof to exercise source-agnosticism. NOT ingestible — no product code produces it.
statuses.vocabulary_only: The id is a member of the union with nothing behind it anywhere. Typeable, never produced. Kept because the union is a vocabulary, recorded because a type member nobody implements reads as a capability.

sources.note: osquery-backed MDM. The open-source engineering lab source named in the launch criterion.
Rugged/shared-Android shape mirroring Headwind CE. Deliberately a shape and an adapter rather than a 52nd connector family — the breadth freeze stands and the contract is the point.

Constructed inline by proof:evidence-adapter to prove the engine cannot distinguish sources. The Graph PRODUCTION path reaches the device-management-health connector through graph-transport.ts instead, which does not emit this contract — so nothing in product code produces sourceSystem: "intune" today.
Constructed inline in the same proof. Registered in the lab registry as REFERENCE_ARCHITECTURE, never deployed.

Named in twelve files as a vendor SignalGrid reads ABOUT (uem, entitlement-binding, provisioning-order), and in none of them does it produce DeviceManagementEvidence. A commercial MDM with no adapter. (unverified count; not reproducible 2026-09-06)

Appears only in the union declaration as an `EvidenceSourceSystem` id (`lib/integration-bridge/src/evidence.ts`). The vendor NAME appears elsewhere (e.g. `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/integrations.ts:298`) without producing this contract.
